description: Header file defining the BalsaFrame class, a lightweight HTTP framer, including its member variables, methods, and associated types.

classes.name: BalsaFrame
classes.description: A class representing a lightweight HTTP framer capable of parsing HTTP messages.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Reinitializes all member variables and clears attached headers and trailer.

methods.name: set_balsa_headers
methods.description: Attaches a BalsaHeaders object to the framer, clearing it first.

methods.name: set_continue_headers
methods.description: Sets headers to be used for 100 Continue responses, clearing previous headers.

methods.name: set_balsa_trailer
methods.description: Attaches a trailer headers object, clearing it first.

methods.name: set_balsa_visitor
methods.description: Sets the visitor interface for callbacks during parsing.

methods.name: set_invalid_chars_level
methods.description: Sets the level of invalid character checking.

methods.name: track_invalid_chars
methods.description: Returns whether invalid character tracking is enabled.

methods.name: invalid_chars_error_enabled
methods.description: Checks if invalid character errors are enabled.

methods.name: set_http_validation_policy
methods.description: Sets the HTTP validation policy.

methods.name: http_validation_policy
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP validation policy.

methods.name: set_is_request
methods.description: Specifies whether the message is a request.

methods.name: is_request
methods.description: Returns whether the message is a request.

methods.name: set_request_was_head
methods.description: Indicates if the request was a HEAD request.

methods.name: set_max_header_length
methods.description: Sets the maximum allowed header length.

methods.name: max_header_length
methods.description: Returns the maximum header length.

methods.name: MessageFullyRead
methods.description: Checks if the message has been fully read.

methods.name: ParseState
methods.description: Returns the current parse state.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Checks if the parser is in an error state.

methods.name: ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the last error code.

methods.name: get_invalid_chars
methods.description: Returns the map of invalid characters encountered.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Returns the attached headers object.

methods.name: mutable_headers
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the headers object.

methods.name: trailer
methods.description: Returns the attached trailer headers.

methods.name: mutable_trailer
methods.description: Returns a mutable pointer to the trailer headers.

methods.name: BytesSafeToSplice
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes safe to splice.

methods.name: BytesSpliced
methods.description: Informs the framer of bytes spliced.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data for parsing.

methods.name: set_allow_reading_until_close_for_request
methods.description: Allows reading until close for requests.

methods.name: AllowArbitraryBody
methods.description: Allows parsing of arbitrary message bodies, e.g., for websockets.

methods.name: set_use_interim_headers_callback
methods.description: Enables or disables interim headers callback.
